name: Portland Youth Conservation Crew
what_you_do: Teen crews work outdoors on trails, trees, community gardens or natural areas. They pull invasive plants, build trails and fences, make maps and care for trees.
who_can_apply: Crew members ages 14 to 18. The page does not list grade requirements. Crew leaders must be at least 18 and have a driver's license.
duration: 2026 crew members worked June 23 to August 7, 8:30 am to 2:30 pm. Summer hires can keep working Saturdays in the school year.
deadline_text: The 2026 season ended. Next summer job applications will be posted early next year (watch the City of Portland job page).
how_to_apply: Apply through the City of Portland job site when the crew member job posts.
notes: Crews: Trail (the hardest work on the body), Tree, Community Gardens, City Nature East, and West Side Nature (No Ivy League). Oregon BOLI does not give work permits to minors ages 14 to 17. Employers need a certificate to hire minors.
